_readme: THE MENUS. `labelKey` points at a key in src/i18n/en.json and km.json — wording lives there, so a label is translated once and reused in every menu. `href` is a plain site path; the language prefix (/km) and the deployment base path are added automatically, so never write them here. `feature` optionally names a switch in site.json → features: when that switch is off, the item disappears from every menu. `childrenFrom`/`itemsFrom` set to "services" pull the three service names straight out of services.json, so a service is renamed in exactly one place.
